description.value: Dublin Crossing is an authentic Irish pub in Surrey serving a full menu of food alongside Irish and local craft draught beers. The venue features live music several nights a week and hosts seasonal events including St. Patrick's Day and Oktoberfest celebrations. Dine-in, patio seating, and take-out are all available.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content is fully available and provides the primary evidence base. The site confirms an active Irish pub at 18789 Fraser Highway, #101, Surrey, BC with phone (604) 575-5470. Take-out is explicitly advertised multiple times ('WE DO TAKE-OUT: 604-575-5470'). No mention of bike racks, bike parking, water refill, washrooms, Wi-Fi, or any cycling-specific amenities anywhere on the site.
concerns: OSM record contains no phone number and only 'Surrey' as the address; full address and phone sourced from website only.
Contact page reservation form asks about 'mobility concerns that would prevent guests from being seated upstairs', indicating upstairs seating with potential accessibility limitations.
OSM address field is incomplete (city only); address used here is taken entirely from the website.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Dublin Crossing is a legitimate, active food and drink business, but no cycling-specific amenities (bike parking, water refill, washrooms) could be confirmed from the website. Needs on-the-ground verification of at least bike parking or visibility before inclusion in the WWC directory.

wow_evidence: authentic Irish pub … live music several nights a week
